title: add-jsonschema-strict-mode-and-improved-error-messages-openai-compat
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Add a strict JSON Schema mode for structured output (response_format=json_schema) and improve validator error messages for both native API and OpenAI compatibility layer. This PR wires strict-mode behavior through the API surface, adds clearer diagnostics for schema validation failures, and ensures backward-compatible handling for older clients. Changes include server-side validation, improved error codes, SDK plumbing, tests, and docs. Checklist: - [x] Implement strict-mode flag handling in API layer - [x] Add detailed validator diagnostics and error codes - [x] Wire through OpenAI compatibility layer to accept response_format param - [x] Add unit and integration tests covering strict and non-strict behavior - [x] Update SDKs and docs - [x] Run CI and fix flaky tests Related: Linear ENG-5123 for structured output quality; ENG-5189 for OpenAI compat response_format param. See design doc: https://redwood.internal/designs/jsonschema-strict-mode. Summary of commits: see commits field below. High level files changed: see files_changed field below. Merge notes: approved by reviewers after addressing review suggestions; CI green except for a flaky benchmark warning which was rebased out. This change is backward compatible when clients omit response_format or set non-strict mode.

motivation_and_context: Structured outputs are increasingly used by clients for deterministic parsing and downstream tooling. Prior behaviour returned opaque validation failures that made debugging difficult. This change introduces a strict validation mode to enforce JSON Schema conformance and adds actionable error messages so integrators can fix prompt/schema mismatches. Also ensures OpenAI compatibility accepts the common response_format parameter so clients migrating from other providers have a predictable experience.
testing: Added unit tests for validator edge cases and diagnostics, integration tests for API and OpenAI compat layer, and manual e2e runs against sample prompt sets. CI run included regression suite. Addressed two flaky tests by increasing timeouts and splitting a heavy fixture into smaller cases.
release_notes: - Add response_format=json_schema strict mode for structured outputs; - Improve validator diagnostics and user-facing error messages for schema validation failures; - OpenAI compatibility layer accepts response_format and strict flags; - Backwards compatible when response_format is omitted; - SDKs (Python/TS) expose response_format and strict_mode options.
merge_summary: Merged via squash after 3 approvals. All required CI checks passed. One benchmark warning noted but non-blocking. Commit message consolidated implementation and docs updates.
